title: refactor(plugin-security): move SecurityPlugin's controlled-by-parent read leaf into security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts (#25223 cut 4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMYdF2uchcinMphEKW4sYxd)_

Part of #25223
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6353073966

Cut 4 of the `security-plugin.ts` split: the rest of cut 2. The claim is 6355875966. The bodies of two synchronous methods move unedited to the new module `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts`:

- `computeControlledByParentFilter`, the ADR-0055 §2 read derivation. It answers a `controlled_by_parent` object's read with the engine's `ReadableIds` leaf over its master (ADR-0139 D6).
- `controlledByParentChainRefusal`, the chain refusal that derivation runs over the registry before it writes the leaf.

The one module-level declaration only those bodies read moves with them: `CBP_LEAF_READ_VERBS`. The `ReadableIds` name leaves the `@objectstack/spec/data` import of `security-plugin.ts`, because no code left there reads it.

It is move-only, and the card stays open for the later cuts. Branch: `claude/project-thread-3fzya4`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` at `3e514912ad` (cut 3's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record.

**Why these two now.** Ruling 6353073966 item 4 held them until the Tier H docs PR for #25314 landed. That PR, #25316, merged as `97967a9a06` before cut 3's merge, and #25314 is closed as completed. On this base, ADR-0055:26 is a file-level anchor and ADR-0055:58 anchors the `assertControlledByParentWrite` method shell, so no ADR sentence resolves on a token inside these two bodies any more. `composeWriteTenantWall`, which item 4 also held, belongs to a different section (the tenant wall) and is not in this cut.

**What stays in `security-plugin.ts`.** `CBP_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH` stays: ADR-0055:135 anchors it by symbol in that file (ruling item 5). It has been exported since cut 3, and the new module imports it by value, as cut 3's module does, so `security-plugin.ts` gains no new export. It is read only inside a function body, at call time, never while either module evaluates. `CbpRelation` keeps its one declaration. Both files import `RLS_DENY_FILTER` from `rls-compiler.js`.

## The published `.d.ts` does not change

Under the series bar (ruling 6348891160 item 1), measured on base `3e514912ad` and on the head (the tree of this PR's commit):

- Raw sha256 of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts`, base and head, all four the same: `803f5bfb7da0b00f8cd8d8f25172463d8dfb07d93fbdd8a9c6f4d4b7435e429a`. The raw diff is 0 lines, so no union order moved either.
- Normalised sha256, all four the same: `b6b5c1b7fa6fa188f6e2f7e4cca3816a246b570f20d708643d116012aa86fa77`.
- The normaliser, run from `packages/plugins/plugin-security` (it sorts the members of each string-literal union and changes nothing else):

```sh
node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum
```

- Positive controls on a copy of the head `dist/index.d.ts`, line 2027 (`private computeControlledByParentFilter;`):
  - Made public (`computeControlledByParentFilter;`): raw `133464a499c14936dfef45acfbfc4dc06f474a637d04a41af9c96cd69467e57b`, normalised `18feab96bc21c749ed55f60542c9564a6f80de841a2e650325229a8167ced6ff`.
  - Renamed (`private computeControlledByParentFilterRenamed;`): raw `702460748f17c01330fd55483961d149a1972622317ba54c89f03a99c2a045f7`, normalised `a7ef310b2e289b480123f13b49aa60391b0e0ee5951cb650296a5f2d757a5759`.
  - Both differ from the real hashes, so the comparison does see a visibility change and a rename.
- Export tables: the ESM and CJS bundles each export the same 63 names at base and head. The lists were loaded at runtime, not parsed. The sorted name list hashes `f607fd765d6b277e08b3b46ccb16d1e2d133ec55658ffe40155aef25e1bf54f0` on all four, the same as at cuts 2 and 3.
- The bundle JS bytes differ (`index.js` `4f2b1fcb` to `7179686c`, `index.mjs` `8a9277ae` to `474e62d2`), because code moved within them.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling 6348891160 item 4.

## What moved

Base line numbers are each member's signature at `3e514912ad`. The last column lists the members the body reads, which is exactly what its host carries.

| method | base lines | host members |
|---|---|---|
| `computeControlledByParentFilter` | `:9058`-`:9099` | `controlledByParentChainRefusal`, `logger`, `ql`, `resolveCbpRelation` |
| `controlledByParentChainRefusal` | `:9123`-`:9140` | `ql`, `resolveCbpRelation` |

Both methods are synchronous, so no stub changes `async`.

`CBP_LEAF_READ_VERBS` (base `:661`, 11 lines with its docblock) moves verbatim. No code left in `security-plugin.ts` reads it.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1 to 3 applied it)

- The class keeps each private method with its name, signature, docblock and position, because tsup emits private members with their JSDoc into the `.d.ts`. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25223 cut 4]`.
- `CbpReadFilterHost` types every member as the class member itself (`SecurityPlugin['m']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads, and each stub annotates its literal with the same `Pick`. There is no cast, and no member becomes public or protected.
- The module imports `SecurityPlugin` type-only, and names `CbpRelation` through the class's own signature, as cuts 2 and 3 do (an alias over the non-null return type of `SecurityPlugin['resolveCbpRelation']`).
- Methods go in as late-bound closures that call `this.m(...a)` on the plugin at call time. A spy or test double set on the plugin is still the one the leaf reaches. The leaf still reaches its chain refusal through the plugin, and both still reach `resolveCbpRelation` through it. No moved body calls a function-valued field, so no receiver changes.
- Fields: `ql` and `logger` go as getters, because neither is declared `readonly`. `start()` assigns both after construction. The host declares both `readonly`, so a moved body cannot assign a member through it; the typecheck passes, so none does.
- Nothing re-exports the module, so the package entry does not move.

## Proof of move-only

- **Bodies, by AST token**: for both methods, the moved function's body has the same TypeScript token sequence as the base method body, and each of its 48 lines is the base line with two leading spaces removed. Parameters, the parameter docblock, return types and `async` match. A negative control, `!context?.userId` changed to `context?.userId` in `computeControlledByParentFilter`, fails the check.
- **Class side**: each method keeps its docblock and signature. `CBP_LEAF_READ_VERBS` is verbatim in the module and absent from `security-plugin.ts`. `CBP_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH` and `CbpRelation` are byte-identical to base. Every other class member, 123 named members plus the constructor, is byte-identical to base, `composeWriteTenantWall` included.
- **git's own view** (`git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change 3e514912ad HEAD` over the two source files): 60 of 61 deleted lines and 75 of 179 added lines are detected as moved.
  - Deleted, not moved (1): the `@objectstack/spec/data` import line, which loses `ReadableIds`. The module imports `ReadableIds` from the same package.
  - Added, not moved: that import line's replacement, the stub bodies, and the import of the new module with its comment. In the module: the license header, the module docblock, the imports, the `CbpRelation` alias, `CbpReadFilterHost`, one pointer docblock per function and the rewritten signature heads. The rest are lines git does not pair with a moved block, such as blanks and closing braces.
- **Size**: 247 changed lines (+186 / -61, 3 files), under the 3000-line human-merge threshold. `security-plugin.ts` goes from 10,240 to 10,205 lines.

## ADR anchors (ruling 6353073966 item 2)

- `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs`: exit 0 at base `3e514912ad` and exit 0 at head, both with `2383 anchors across 142 records resolve — 466 symbol (440 declaration, 26 literal), 1889 file-level, 28 cross-repo, 6 exempt, 18 continuation`. The counts differ from cut 3's report because #25316 made one symbol anchor file-level. CI runs this gate (`lint.yml`), but `dispatch-gates --commands` does not derive it for this change set (#21697), so it is run by hand here.
- `pnpm check:adr-anchors`: exit 0, 78 anchored files (77 at base, plus the new entry). The new entry is `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__plugins__plugin-security__src__security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts.json`. It carries ADR-0055 and the §1 invariant paragraph of the `security-plugin.ts` entry, verbatim, as the entries of cuts 2 and 3 do. Its "reads answer RLS_DENY_FILTER" half is this leaf. The moved comments also cite ADR-0139. Like the `security-plugin.ts` entry, the new entry does not list every ADR its file cites, and the gate passes. The `security-plugin.ts` entry is unchanged. `docs/adr/**` is not touched.
- The anchor map covers every ADR symbol anchor naming `security-plugin.ts`: 27 anchors, 18 symbols, 10 ADRs on this base. It was measured with `extractAnchors` and `symbolSegmentResolution` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`, which is measurement, not a new gate. It was read on `3e514912ad` BEFORE the cut, with the two bodies blanked: no anchor changed class. Every anchor resolves at head in `security-plugin.ts` with its base class.

The three anchors that name `computeControlledByParentFilter` resolve on its declaration, which stays as a shell. `assertControlledByParentWrite`, `assertMasterRowEditable`, `collectRLSPolicies` and `computeRlsFilter` also appear as host-literal keys inside cut 3's stubs, as cut 3's report noted; this cut adds no such line for an anchored name.

## Readers

No test, script, gate, baseline or docs anchor reads the moved lines by path, so nothing else is re-pointed.

- **The census pages.** The two bodies hold no `isSystem` read, so `check-system-context-census` has no row to move. Unlike cut 3, `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` is not touched. The gate exits 0 at base and head with the same summary except the file count. The bodies hold no engine write, so `check-tenant-audit-census` sees the same 237 write call sites.

The method still exists under that name.
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts` describes the enforcement as `plugin-security/security-plugin.ts computeControlledByParentFilter + assertControlledByParentWrite`. Both are still methods of that class in that file, now as shells, as cut 3 already left `assertControlledByParentWrite`.

The literals moved unchanged and no behaviour changed, so there is nothing to edit on those pages.

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing outside this cut is touched: no other section of the class, no behaviour, no other lane's file, and no `docs/adr/**`.
- Serial check, also in the claim: of the open PRs, only #25355 touches `security-plugin.ts`, with one import after `:47` and one block at `:1765`. This cut has no hunk near either.
- What is left of the controlled-by-parent section in `security-plugin.ts` after this cut: the method shells, `CBP_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH`, `CbpRelation` and `cbpRelCache`. `composeWriteTenantWall` gets its own cut.
